text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we've had 3 latency spikes hitting the /v1/generate path over the past 72h, looks correlated to longer seqs and tail RTs. I'm proposing a short SLO retune + new dashboard slices to surface the pattern. Quick sync? :eyes:

alex: saw the alerts. can you paste the incident IDs? i want to check if it's the same shard or traffic surge.

maya: 2312341000, 2312343000, 2312345200 — all show >95th pct token latency jump. Not the same host pool, seems workload pattern (longer contexts).

nora: agree we should avoid dialing down SLO silently. proposal: keep core SLO but add a transient tail SLO for long-context requests and a separate throughput SLO for batch endpoints.

jordan: +1. can we do this without changing customer-facing SLAs? prefer internal monitoring SLOs first and then a roll proposal for external SLA if needed.

maya: exactly. suggested internal SLOs (draft):
- /v1/generate (all): p99 token RT < 250ms
- /v1/generate (long-context >=1024): p95 token RT < 420ms (new internal tail SLO)
- batch-embed throughput: 1000 reqs/min per pool (throughput SLO)
These are conservative and we can tweak after a week of data.

sam: do we have dashboard widgets for long-context split today? i can add a panel but need the metric tag.

maya: metric is inference.token_latency_ms with label context_length_bucket. currently buckets: short/medium/long. use long >=1024.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: grafana/dashboards/slo-tail-slices will be created in staging at 2026-04-01T02:00Z.

alex: action items: 1) create staging dashboard and smoke tests (owner: sam) 2) deploy internal SLO config to staging (owner: maya) 3) run 7-day synthetic for long-context (owner: nora) 4) review and decide external SLA change (owner: jordan). ETA: 2 weeks for first pass.

nora: i'll start the synthetic harness tomorrow. tagging known flaky workload (large prompts) to reproduce.

sam: i'll spin up the dashboard panels and add alerts for p95/p99 regressions and a heatmap for context_length. aiming to have staging link by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:

jordan: i'll draft a short stakeholder note for PMs and account teams explaining this is an internal monitoring change and only a customer SLA change if trend persists.

maya: thanks. one more ask — can eng-sre add an automated runbook check that flags repeated tail burns as a recurring incident pattern? we've had a couple in past 2 months. Owner?

alex: assigning recurring-pattern detector to me. i'll add a rule in the incident classifier and alert to the SLO channel if a similar spike happens 3x in 30d.

ops-bot: note: issue tracker ticket created #INC-4571 for SLO retune work.

maya: perfect. TL;DR: don't change public SLA yet, create internal tail SLO + dashboard, run synthetic and 2-week observation, then decision point. Owners and ETAs as above. I'll schedule a 30m sync for next Tuesday to review staging metrics.

sam: link for staging dash when ready pls.

nora: standing up harness now, will post results in thread.

alex: thanks team — keep the thread updated. :white_check_mark:
